name: fusion-vision-mcp
description: An MCP server fusing Florence-2, Moondream2, SAM2, Grounding DINO, EasyOCR, IQA and CLIP for image captioning, OCR, object detection/grounding, instance counting, visual question answering, spatial measurement and aesthetic scoring

memory_mode.title: Memory mode
memory_mode.description: How long the vision models stay in memory after their last use, trading memory against speed. "aggressive" releases them after 5 minutes idle (lowest memory). "standard" releases them after 10 minutes. "persistent" never releases them (fastest, highest memory). You can also enter a number of minutes, such as 30. Models always reload automatically on the next request, so no setting can lose work -- only time.

device.title: Compute device
device.description: Which torch build to install. "cpu" runs everything on the processor and is the default -- it works everywhere and downloads about 2 GB less. "cu130" installs the CUDA 13 build for an NVIDIA GPU (Linux or Windows; requires a driver supporting CUDA 13, and pulls roughly 2 GB of CUDA runtime). Verified on an RTX 5060 (Blackwell, sm_120). macOS uses its own CPU/MPS build regardless, so leave this at "cpu" there.

tools.name: ocr
tools.description: Transcribe text from an image or PDF, backed by EasyOCR. Handles printed, stylized, cursive and low-contrast text alike, so there is no second tool to route to. Set detail=true to also get the bounding box and confidence score for each text span. Multi-column pages are split by geometry and read in reading order. An image with no text returns an empty result, which is the correct answer, not a failure.

tools.name: caption
tools.description: Describe what an image shows, as one detailed prose caption of the whole scene. Set verify_text=true to also run OCR and return verbatim text spans, a corrections list of the close misses, and a caption_corrected copy with the verbatim OCR text substituted in.

tools.name: detect_objects
tools.description: Locate a named object in an image, returning bounding boxes, center points and labels.

tools.name: dense_region_caption
tools.description: Caption every salient region of an image at once, with bounding boxes, without naming objects first.

tools.name: query_image
tools.description: Ask a free-form question about an image (visual question answering), backed by Moondream2. Set check_consistency=true to re-ask a rephrased control question and flag the answer 'low' confidence when the two agree on a flat default ('None'/'Yes') or contradict each other; on a low-confidence answer it also routes to the measurement that answers the question (spatial_relations/count_objects/ocr) as cross_check when one applies.

tools.name: count_objects
tools.description: Count how many instances of a named object an image contains, backed by Grounding DINO. Use this, not detect_objects, whenever the question is "how many". Adds a consensus second-opinion count and a separability flag by default; on a collapse, adds an actionable outline estimate (and an optional vqa_estimate).

tools.name: batch_analyze_images
tools.description: Run one operation across many images in a single call, isolating failures per image.

tools.name: spatial_relations
tools.description: Measure contact, gaps, containment depth and shape between named objects using SAM2 masks.

tools.name: score_aesthetics
tools.description: Rate how aesthetically pleasing an image looks on a 1-10 scale, using the CLIP/LAION predictor. Set style_context=true to also classify the medium (photograph, oil painting, ...) so the photography-biased score is read in context. Set compare_with to a reference image for a calibrated like-with-like comparison (delta + preferred) instead of a single bias-affected absolute score.

tools.name: critique_composition
tools.description: Critique an image's framing against the rule of thirds and explain, for low-scoring shots, what looks off. Set style_context=true to also classify the medium so the photography-biased score is read in context. Set compare_with to critique two images and report which is preferred.

tools.name: process
tools.description: Run a raw Florence-2 task token against an image, for tasks the named tools do not cover.
